semantics.fallback: Invoke untouched original SolveContactsInternal on every bypassed call

transitionRules: When optimization state is ineligible: original method, no certification query.
When Remaining>0: decrement and call original method. No previous support answer is returned.
When overlap says blocked: set Remaining=8, call original method.
When overlap clear: retain original terrain sample/fallback and all joint sweeps; do not cache clear.
Do not join Drive and Displace, and do not reuse either endpoint result.
counterexamples: A door/vehicle is removed while backoff active: only optimization delayed; original ray checks still execute.
An obstacle arrives after a clear result: next eligible attempt performs a new overlap; no positive reuse.
State changes to FALL/hit/death: old full method owns safety; no cached lift/points returned.
